rules.rule_context:
COMPLIANCE NOTE - PAYMENT CONTROLS (APPLICABLE TO ALL SUPPLIER BANK DETAIL CHANGES)

Scope: Any request to add, modify, or replace supplier banking information held in Meridian's vendor master file, regardless of dollar amount, payment method, or invoice urgency classification. This includes routing number changes, account number changes, bank name changes, and any instruction to remit to an account not on file.

Exclusions: Address changes, contact email updates, purchase order modifications, and payment date adjustments where banking details remain unchanged.

Verification requirement: Before updating vendor master file banking details, the AP operator must complete voice verification with a known contact at the supplier whose identity was previously confirmed through prior payment relationship or independent directory lookup. Callback must use a phone number obtained from Meridian's existing vendor file, from a prior verified invoice, or from independent directory verification. Numbers supplied solely through the current change request channel (email, PDF, phone call initiating the change) are not acceptable for the callback.

Prohibition on partial or deferred verification: No payment may be initiated to new banking details until voice confirmation is obtained and documented. Split payments, percentage holds, or post-payment verification are not permitted workarounds. The timing of the invoice (including supplier-marked urgency, internal pay-on-time targets, or escalated status) does not override this requirement.

Documentation: Log callback date, time, phone number source, name and title of person verified, and summary of confirmation in the vendor master change ticket. Retain records per SOX control PC-7.2.
